notes: Session/state envelope for WorldAI Mini MCP. Normative source: design doc section 4 (session and state schema) with sections 11-13 amendments.
Model-owned containers (player, gm_notes, recap) preserve unknown keys; control envelope rejects them.
Server-owned values (revision, ids, timestamps, operation history, roll receipts, quotas, gm_note_guard ledger) live outside state and are never patchable.

gm_note_guard.description: Server-owned ledger: normalized note text, stable path and digest tombstones. Not patchable, not player-readable, not exportable. Retained across model deletion for session lifetime.
